mapper.select:
select FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME text, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID object from FIN_PRODUCT
inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.GRA_FUND_TYPE = #{graFundType}
and (FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
and （FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID IN (#{initValue}) or FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IN (#{initValue}))
and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{finprodType2})

SELECT FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, FINPROD_ABBR FINPROD_ABBR, FINPROD_NAME FINPROD_NAME, PROFIT_TYPE PROFIT_TYPE, COUPON_SPECIES COUPON_SPECIES, CHL_FINPROD_ID CHL_FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_MARKET_ID, ISSUE_ID ISSUE_ID, ISSUE_PRICE ISSUE_PRICE, ISSUE_AMT ISSUE_AMT, CCY CCY, BLN_AREA BLN_AREA, TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, CALENDAR_ID CALENDAR_ID, ISSUE_TYPE ISSUE_TYPE, OPERATION_TYPE OPERATION_TYPE, ENTRUST_TYPE ENTRUST_TYPE, ENTRUSTER ENTRUSTER, TRUSTEE_ID TRUSTEE_ID, ISSUER ISSUER, IDATE IDATE, VDATE VDATE, MDATE MDATE, TERM_DAYS TERM_DAYS, ACTMDATE ACTMDATE, LIQUIDATION_DATE LIQUIDATION_DATE, IS_CHL IS_CHL, IS_SUS IS_SUS, SUSTAINABLE_REMARK SUSTAINABLE_REMARK, IS_RIGHT IS_RIGHT, CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE, P_FINPROD_ID P_FINPROD_ID, O_FINPROD_ID O_FINPROD_ID, REGIST_ORG REGIST_ORG, REMARK REMARK, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_NAME NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_NAME FROM FIN_PRODUCT GROUP BY FINPROD_NAME HAVING count( FINPROD_NAME ) > 1 ) OR FINPROD_ABBR NOT IN ( SELECT FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT GROUP BY FINPROD_ABBR HAVING count( FINPROD_ABBR ) > 1 )

SELECT distinct PFLSH id, PFLSH text, SEQNO || ',' || CREDIT_MST_ID || ',' || CREDIT_FLAG object FROM CREDIT_LINES
(CREDIT_MST_ID = #{ZCSX,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (CUSTOMER_ID is null OR CUSTOMER_ID = '')) or (CREDIT_MST_ID = #{XLSX,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
or (PFLSH = #{pfhId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
and PFLSH like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')

SELECT distinct CUSTOMER_ID FROM CREDIT_LINES
SEQNO = #{seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT CUSTOMER_ID id, CUSTOMER_NAME text FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO
CUSTOMER_TYPE = #{CUSTOMER_TYPE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and ( CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
and (CUSTOMER_ID IN (#{initValue}) or CUSTOMER_NAME IN (#{initValue}))
SELECT PARTY_TYPE1, PARTY_TYPE2, PARTY_TYPE3, INDUSTRY, INDUSTRY2 FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD where CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId}
SELECT T1.MDATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 WHERE (T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} OR T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId} )

select R1.CASH_ID CASH_IDXJL , R1.EFF_DATE EFF_DATEXJL , R1.CALC_TYPE CALC_TYPEXJL , R1.BASE_TYPE BASE_TYPEXJL , R1.BASE_DATE_TYPE BASE_DATE_TYPEXJL , R1.BASIS BASISXJL , R1.YIELD YIELDXJL , R1.IS_INITIAL IS_INITIALXJL , R1.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_IDXJL , R1.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPEXJL , R1.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2XJL , R1.BRANCH BRANCHXJL , R1.REMARK REMARKXJL , R1.CREATE_USER CREATE_USERXJL , R1.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPTXJL , R1.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIMEXJL , R1.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USERXJL , R1.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIMEXJL from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R1 where 1=1
and R1.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and R1.BRANCH = 0 order by R1.FINPROD_ID,R1.EFF_DATE

select FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID CASH_IDJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_IDJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.BRANCH BRANCHJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CREATE_USER CREATE_USERJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIMEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USERJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIMEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_NUM CASH_NUMJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_TYPE CASH_TYPEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE_UNADJUST VDATE_UNADJUSTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE_UNADJUST MDATE_UNADJUSTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST PAY_DATE_UNADJUSTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE VDATEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE MDATEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_DATE PAY_DATEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.TERMDAYS TERMDAYSJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE_Y VDATE_YJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.VDATE_TERM VDATE_TERMJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE_TERM MDATE_TERMJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.TERMDAYS_TERM TERMDAYS_TERMJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.INT_PRIN_AMT INT_PRIN_AMTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.INT_AMT INT_AMTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.IS_PAY_INT IS_PAY_INTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_AMT CASH_AMTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_BASEAMT CASH_BASEAMTJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_UNIT_TYPE CASH_UNIT_TYPEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.CALC_FUNCTION CALC_FUNCTIONJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.FREQUENCY FREQUENCYJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2JH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.PAY_TYPE PAY_TYPEJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.RANGE_YIELD RANGE_YIELDJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.REMARK REMARKJH, FIN_CASH_PLAN.REPAY_WITHOUT_INT REPAY_WITHOUT_INTJH, FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID CASH_IDXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 CASH_TYPE_1XX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 CASH_TYPE_2XX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CCY CCYXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_IDXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPEXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH BRANCHXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID FEE_IDXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CHL_FINPROD_ID CHL_FINPROD_IDXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CHL_LEVEL CHL_LEVELXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.IS_CALC IS_CALCXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CREATE_USER CREATE_USERXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPTXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIMEXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USERXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIMEXX, FIN_CASH_INFO.COLLECT_TYPE COLLECT_TYPEXX, case when exists (select 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID and nvl(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.SETTLE_DATE) = FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N') then 'Y' else 'N' end paidOrNot from FIN_CASH_INFO inner join FIN_CASH_PLAN on FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PLAN.CASH_ID where 1=1
and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = 0 order by FIN_CASH_PLAN.FINPROD_ID,FIN_CASH_PLAN.MDATE

select T1.CASH_ID CASH_IDXQ , T1.EXERCISE_TYPE , T1.VDATE VDATEXQ , T1.MDATE MDATEXQ , T1.EXERCISE_DATE , T1.EXERCISE_STATUS , T1.EXERCISE_PRICE , T1.EXERCISE_REMARK , T1.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_IDXQ , T1.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPEXQ , T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2XQ , T1.BRANCH BRANCHXQ , T1.CREATE_USER CREATE_USERXQ , T1.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPTXQ , T1.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIMEXQ , T1.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USERXQ , T1.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIMEXQ , T1.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE as ACT_EXERCISE_DATE from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN T1 where 1=1
and T1.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and T1.EXERCISE_TYPE in
#{item}
AND T1.EXERCISE_DATE >= to_date(#{paramDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T1.EXERCISE_DATE = (select min(T2.EXERCISE_DATE) from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN T2 where T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
and T2.EXERCISE_TYPE in
#{item}
AND T2.EXERCISE_DATE >= to_date(#{paramDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and not exists (select 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where (TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID or TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.ps in ('T03','T39')) and T2.FINPROD_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.FINPROD_ID and nvl(TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE,TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.MDATE) = T2.EXERCISE_DATE and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.IS_CANCEL = 'N' ))

select R1.CASH_ID cashId, R1.EFF_DATE effDate, R1.PAY_CYCLE_VAL payCycleVal, R1.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, R1.DAY_TYPE dayType, R1.DAY_VALUE dayValue, R1.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, R1.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, R1.CALC_RULE calcRule, R1.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, R1.CASH_UNIT_TYPE cashUnitType, R1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, R1.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, R1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, R1.BRANCH branch, R1.PAY_TYPE payType, R1.REMARK remark, R1.CREATE_USER createUser, R1.CREATE_DEPT createDept, R1.CREATE_TIME createTime, R1.UPDATE_USER updateUser, R1.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, R1.PAY_MONTH payMonth from fin_cash_pay_rule R1 inner join fin_product on R1.FINPROD_ID = fin_product.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
and R1.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and R1.BRANCH = 0 and R1.EFF_DATE =fin_product.vdate

select A.cashId, A.openType, A.openDateStrUn, A.openDateEndUn, A.openVdateUn, A.openMdateUn, A.openDateStr, A.openDateEnd, A.openVdate, A.openMdate, A.finprodId, A.branch, A.openStatus, A.createUser, A.createDept, A.createTime, A.updateUser, A.updateTime, A.openNdate from ( select FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_TYPE openType, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR_UN openDateStrUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_END_UN openDateEndUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_VDATE_UN openVdateUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_MDATE_UN openMdateUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR openDateStr, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_END openDateEnd, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_VDATE openVdate, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_MDATE openMdate, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.BRANCH branch, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_STATUS openStatus, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CREATE_USER createUser, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CREATE_DEPT createDept, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CREATE_TIME createTime, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.UPDATE_USER updateUser, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_NDATE openNdate from FIN_OPEN_PLAN inner join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} where 1=1
and FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_TYPE in (#{openTypeshui},#{openTypesh}) and FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR = (select min(T.OPEN_DATE_STR) from FIN_OPEN_PLAN T where T.FINPROD_ID = FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID
AND T.OPEN_DATE_STR > to_date(#{paramDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and T.OPEN_TYPE in (#{openTypeshui},#{openTypesh})) union all select FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_TYPE openType, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR_UN openDateStrUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_END_UN openDateEndUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_VDATE_UN openVdateUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_MDATE_UN openMdateUn, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR openDateStr, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_END openDateEnd, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_VDATE openVdate, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_MDATE openMdate, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.BRANCH branch, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_STATUS openStatus, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CREATE_USER createUser, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CREATE_DEPT createDept, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.CREATE_TIME createTime, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.UPDATE_USER updateUser, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_NDATE openNdate from FIN_OPEN_PLAN inner join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} where 1=1
and FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
and FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR = (select min(T.OPEN_DATE_STR) from FIN_OPEN_PLAN T where T.FINPROD_ID = FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID
AND T.OPEN_DATE_STR > to_date(#{paramDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
))A order by A.finprodId,A.openVdate
